warning.titlePre: Jaguar XK 5.0 V8 Timing Chain Tensioner Wear
paragraphs: If your XK 5.0 V8 is an X150-generation model with the AJ133 — that's the 5.0-litre V8 fitted from 2005 to 2014, particularly 2012–2014 models — timing chain tensioner failure is the single most frequently reported issue on this engine, based on independent analysis of 2,500+ owner reports. We replace the timing chain, tensioners and guides as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: verified via multiple independent sources (au7o.io, rrsport.co.uk lawsuit list), per G-BRF-Jaguar.md and VRF-jaguar-xk.md. This is the same class-action lawsuit scope covering this exact engine across multiple JLR models.
